notes.title: Latest Patch Notes (4/10/2015)
notes.content:
As an update, for those of you who may be seeing a blank screen, I've added an option to disable some of the advanced graphical features in the settings. If you check this box, restart the game, see if you are able to see the game.

I'm also working on making the extra windows not be separate screens and will post an update when that happens.
